description: The Super Game Agent — the Unity & Unreal for AI agents, with 100+ viral games to remix. Turn 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, etc.) into a full-stack AI game studio. Build and publish 3D & mini-games to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok, Telegram, itch.io, and more.
